title: Reuse old gradients under a later symmetric controller without scalarizing it
statement: For one fixed symmetric K<muI, A=muI-K,B=LI-K,C=B^-1,D=A^-1-B^-1>0, change old jets to z_i=g_i-Kx_i,h_i=x_i,H_i=h_i-Cz_i. Exact common-source weights are wK[j,i]=H_j.(z_i-z_j)+(H_i-H_j)^T D^-1(H_i-H_j)/2. No positive cycles iff one global original energy realizes the fixed-controller portfolio.

General noisy acceptance, nonsymmetric feedback, microscopic restrictions and transient dynamics are outside scope. body: Apply conjugacy to E-x.K.x/2 and subtract C curvature; a conceptual metric square root proves the reduction, while rational inverses suffice computationally. For one old jet, M=(mu+L)I/2-K,r=(L-mu)/2,dload=p-(g_i-Kx_i), ||dload-Mq||^2<=r^2||q||^2 is a sharp quadratic-source ellipsoid for q=x-x_i. With more jets it is only outer. Exact readings, symmetric controller and supplied global source warrants are essential; no general noisy or nonsymmetric extension.
